desc: Derive and verify the per-pair contribution rule: for i<j with A_i≠A_j, diff[M-A_i] -= 1 and diff[M-A_j] += 1; equal pairs contribute nothing (verified on samples 1–3 by hand).
Establish closed-form per-index accumulation: diff[M-A_t] += (t-1-preCnt) - (N-t-postCnt), requiring only tot counts and a running count — no per-pair BIT queries needed for the diff.
Compute base inversion number with a Fenwick (BIT) over values 0..M-1, O(N log M).
Single pass t=1..N maintaining running counts to accumulate diff (size M+1 to allow index M when A_t=0).
Prefix-sum diff for k=0..M-1, add baseInv, output M lines via '\n'.join.
Final review: edge cases N=1 (all answers 0), M=1 (all B_i=0, answers 0), all-equal A (diff all zero, answer constant), large values (Python int OK).
